text: The LORD is my shepherd; I lack nothing.
He lets me lie down in green pastures; he leads me beside quiet waters.
He renews my life; he guides me along the right paths for the sake of his own name.
Even when I walk through the darkest valley, I will not be afraid, for you are with me; your rod and your staff comfort me.
You prepare a table for me in front of my enemies; you anoint my head with oil; my cup overflows.
Surely goodness and faithful love will follow me every day of my life, and I will live in the LORD's house for the rest of my days.
